_comment: Your own CFB coach skin-tone choices. Head asset name -> tone 1-8. Layered on top of the app's bundled data/cfbCoachTones.json, and wins over it. Safe to delete: every coach here just goes back to being guessed.
_fallbackComment: Tone distribution measured from the 263 CFB coaches in the sample dynasty
whose heads DO encode a tone. Used to pick a tone for unmapped coaches, so
the fallback matches how CFB actually populates its coaching pool rather
than how Madden happens to distribute its head art (which skews differently:
Selection stays deterministic -- the same seeded rng as everything else.
